notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
easyPrerequisites: Accomplished Alchemist and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Accomplished Alchemist, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
